settings.headline: Why a bag, and not much else
settings.body:
We were never going to do a big merchandise line. What kept coming up was a smaller, duller problem: people carrying a tube, a cloth and a pack of wipes loose in a handbag on the way to an appointment.

So we made the thing that solves that, and stopped there. If we add to this page it will be for the same reason — something the appointment actually needs — and not because a logo fits on it.

settings.caption: Zip-top, cream, silver-tone zip. Sized for the appointment kit.

settings.heading: Nothing on this page goes on your skin
settings.body: Worth saying plainly, because the rest of the site is topical products with safety assessments behind them. Merchandise has none of that, and needs none of it — no strength tier, no CPSR, no directions for use. If you came looking for the range itself, it's one click away.

settings.question: Is Senseless merchandise a cosmetic product?
settings.answer: No. Nothing on this page is applied to skin, so none of it carries a strength tier or a safety assessment. Those belong to the range proper.

settings.question: Do you ship merchandise with the rest of an order?
settings.answer: Yes — it goes in the same parcel and counts towards free UK delivery like anything else.

settings.question: Will there be more merchandise?
settings.answer: Possibly, but only where it earns its place. We'd rather have one bag people use than a page of branded things nobody needs.
